_comment: No Figma component. The Frontend hardcodes #EAB308 / #FEFCE8 — which are exactly the system's status.warning.default and status.warning.soft-light, so the component binds the roles the Frontend was reaching for. Built per the amended authority rule (2026-08-20). Kept separate from Toast: Toast is transient feedback with four types and a dismiss control; Alert is a static inline warning with none of that.

_source.gap / padding / radius: Frontend `gap-4 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl` = 16 / 16x8 / 16 — every one lands on the scale exactly.
_source.colors: `border-[#EAB308] bg-[#FEFCE8]` — byte-identical to status.warning.default and .soft-light. The literal in the Frontend was the system colour all along.
_source.icon: warning-2-icon-filled, white, in a 28px (`min-h-7`) warning-yellow circle — the set's filled-Warning-2.
_source.description-line-height: The Frontend overrides caption.md.regular's 16px line-height with `leading-[22px]`. Kept verbatim as a literal; no role carries 10/22.

_frontend_evidence.component: lotteryplus-frontend-main/src/components/common/alert — 1 usage, kept because the Standard section 3.4 lists alert as a canonical molecule
_frontend_evidence.implementation: icon circle + [title body_l_semb, description caption_m_reg] on text.secondary

_verified_from.scope: token mirror searched for alert/banner; frontend component + module css read in full
_verified_from.result: VERIFIED ABSENT in Figma. Frontend is the authority per the amended rule (user decision 2026-08-20).

_unmigrated_type._note: Typography literals with no role to bind to, kept deliberately. The token names below are what check-typography.py accepts; anything not listed fails.
_unmigrated_type.description-line-height: 22px — the Frontend overrides caption/md/regular's 16 with leading-[22px]. No role carries 10/22.
